SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN (
    SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(*) AS lang_count
    FROM countrylanguage
    GROUP BY CountryCode
) lc ON c.Code = lc.CountryCode
ORDER BY lc.lang_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
